title: Ladybug wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,8 38,34 62,34' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 44,21 56,21' fill='#ff6ec7'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='7' r='3' fill='#7ef7ff'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='17' r='1.8' fill='#7ef7ff'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='25' r='1.8' fill='#7ef7ff'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='14' fill='#2b2b3a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='14' fill='none' stroke='#6a6a8a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='42' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='42' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='44.5' cy='42.5' r='2' fill='#1a1a2a'/>
  <circle cx='56.5' cy='42.5' r='2' fill='#1a1a2a'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M45 49 Q50 53 55 49' stroke='#7ef7ff' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Antennae -->
  <path d='M42 32 Q36 24 33 20' stroke='#2b2b3a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 32 Q64 24 67 20' stroke='#2b2b3a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='19' r='2.5' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='19' r='2.5' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <!-- Body / wings -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='25' ry='22' fill='#ff3b4e'/>
  <path d='M50 50 L50 90' stroke='#2b2b3a' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <!-- Spots -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='62' r='4.5' fill='#2b2b3a'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='62' r='4.5' fill='#2b2b3a'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='78' r='4' fill='#2b2b3a'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='78' r='4' fill='#2b2b3a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='68' r='3.5' fill='#2b2b3a'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <path d='M27 60 L16 56' stroke='#2b2b3a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M25 70 L14 70' stroke='#2b2b3a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M27 80 L16 84' stroke='#2b2b3a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M73 60 L84 56' stroke='#2b2b3a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M75 70 L86 70' stroke='#2b2b3a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M73 80 L84 84' stroke='#2b2b3a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
